description: Polls get_import_status until the import reaches a terminal state (FINISHED, FINISHED_WITH_WARNINGS, FAILED, CANCELED, REVERTED). Exponential backoff (2s → 1.5× → cap 30s). Default timeout 600s — if exceeded, returns { status: 'POLLING', importId, lastSeen } so the LLM can re-call. Includes a per-type result count summary on terminal states (INFO / WARNING / ERROR; null if the server didn't return totals).

importId.description: Import id from list_imports or execute_import.

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait before returning POLLING. Default 600.

name: wait_for_import

importId.description: Echoed back when status='POLLING' so the LLM can re-call wait_for_import.

lastSeen.description: Last get_import_status response observed before the timeout, present when status='POLLING'.

status.description: Either a terminal status (FINISHED, FINISHED_WITH_WARNINGS, FAILED, CANCELED, REVERTED) or 'POLLING' if timeoutSeconds elapsed.

summary.description: Per-type result counts on terminal states. Values may be null if the server didn't return totals.
